title: SAM Song / Drill Document
description: Shape of a hand-authored or MCP-authored SAM song / drill document. Consumed by React (SongLoader) and by the Edge Function (append_sam_measures). See docs/technical-spec-sam-drills-and-lineage.md § 4.

songType.description: Optional. Absent OR null means 'original' (preserves every pre-existing document). Null is accepted because an export emits every field it knows about, using null for 'this song has no value', rather than omitting keys.

parentSongId.description: UUID of a parent song. Optional. `simplified` requires it; `drill` may or may not.

generationNotes.description: Receipt for human reading. Not source for a build step; derivation is a historical fact, not a live dependency.

fifths.description: MusicXML <fifths>. Authoritative key signature — `key` is a display label whose mode is unreliable (the parser derives it from a major-only table). Null when it could not be established without guessing.

timeSignature.description: Song-level default, e.g. '4/4'. Per-measure timeSignature overrides.

formatVersion.description: Export format version. Absent / null == the original unversioned {title, artist, defaultBpm, measures} export. 2 adds key/fifths, lineage, sourceXmlPath, lyrics, fingerings, and an always-present per-measure audioOffsetMs.

sourceXmlPath.description: Path into the sam-scores Storage bucket holding the original MusicXML. Informational on import — no import path writes it; only a MusicXML upload populates the column.

lyrics.description: Placed (and unplaced) syllables, in sam_song_lyrics's own shape. Written back verbatim on import. word_order is the stable identity of a syllable and must be preserved across a round trip. measure_num null = not yet placed.

fingerings.description: RH fingering cues for sam_song_fingerings. The parser emits these without `source` (all editorial); an export includes it so manual fingerings survive a round trip as manual.

word_order.description: Global syllable sequence within the song. Unique per song.

noteIndex.description: Which notehead within a chord event. Defaults to 0.

not.description: beats[] is legacy and unsupported by sam_song_measures. Use rh[]/lh[].
Authored documents must not carry inline lyric — recompileMeasures strips inline lyrics and re-injects from sam_song_lyrics. An authored lyric would vanish on first recompile.

duration.description: VexFlow token: base note w/h/q/8/16/32 with optional 'd' per augmentation dot (hd, qd, 8d).

notes.description: Simultaneous pitches at this event's onset. Empty array [] means a rest. `noDuplicatePitches` is a custom Ajv keyword (registered by src/sam/lib/noteDuplicates.js and its Deno port): no two notes here may share a `midi` unless one is a tie continuation. Draft-07 cannot compare sibling array items, so the rule cannot be a plain constraint; a validator that does not know the keyword ignores it.

position.description: OPTIONAL. Spec §3.3 keeps storage token-based — 'position stays implied in storage' — and durations.fromTimeline deliberately emits {actual, normal} only. Requiring it meant no parser-produced score containing a tuplet could pass this schema, so no such song could be exported and re-imported. Renderers derive position from a run of consecutive tuplet events.

name.description: Display spelling: step, then optional accidental (# / b / ## / bb), then octave (-1..9). Examples: 'A4', 'Bb4', 'F#3', 'C-1'.
